'''Alexandre "Àlex" Martínez Palau''' (born 10 October 1998) is an Andorran [[association football|footballer]] and [[beach soccer]] player who plays for [[Atlètic Club d'Escaldes]] and the [[Andorra national football team]].<ref>{{NFT player|pid=64377|name=Alexandre Martínez}}</ref>
